checks.description: The briefing validates against greenroom-schema.json (cwi-greenroom/v1): required keys present, every verified fact carries a non-empty source and a valid observation date, every no-go line carries a reason, every likely question carries an approved answer, updated is a valid date. Brand rule: the official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset (index.html, announce.html) — no page renders without the badge.

Only verified CWI facts ship: artist identity (Frederick MD, Cumulative Web Inc), 24-track catalog, Zooted Zone 307,439 lifetime plays observed 2026-09-14, New Rap Hits placements #21/#30/#31 verified 2026-09-15, Diabolique 2026-07-03 at Cue Recording Studio Arlington VA produced by Hybrid, Flamerz by Jeck Da General, Kokurcho BET-nominated and RIAA-certified, contact hp@cumulativeweb.com. Approved answers and angles contain none of the deny patterns (unverified curator claims, momentum projection, false tech claims). No-go lines quote forbidden claims only to forbid them.
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.

EQUIP / CONFIGURE / APPLY steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (briefing, schema, card, page, compass hub, contact) is live, and the APPLY block is a valid briefing-fetch + draft-scan snippet that reads deny patterns from the briefing itself.

evidence.briefing-schema-conformance: every fact has source+date, every no-go line has a reason, every question has an approved answer — asserted in automated gate 1; schema required-key mirror in gate 3; logo.jpg present in index.html and announce.html
evidence.give-block-operability: give-block.md EQUIP/CONFIGURE/APPLY reference greenroom.json, schema, item-card, page, compass hub, hp@cumulativeweb.com — all live per gate 2; APPLY snippet reads deny_patterns from the briefing at runtime
evidence.verified-facts-integrity: gate 1 asserts the observed-metric strings, placement strings, credit strings, and the date-on-every-fact rule; deny-pattern scan over facts/angles/answers clean
evidence.white-label-config: gate 4 builds a temp config.json override (orgName/productName/colors) through build.py and confirms the overrides land in index.html with no leftover tokens

self_evaluation.run: automated: greenroom/test.py gate 4 evaluates the product against this rubric
